description: Downloads a ready-to-attach PDF report for the incident. Returns metadata plus the base64-encoded file. Section composition is controlled by `sections` (`ai_summary`, `diagnostics`, `technical_reference`, `events`). Requires `incident_report_enabled` on the plan — otherwise 403.

sections.description: Which sections to include. Defaults to all on the server side.

name: incident_get_report_pdf
title: Download incident PDF report
